# Battery SOS

> Battery SOS is a menu-bar app for Apple silicon Macs on macOS 13 or later. It shows its own full-screen warning when the battery reaches a level from 1% to 10%. The default is 1%.

Battery SOS does not replace macOS power management and does not control the macOS low-battery notification. If that system warning is hidden by Focus or notification settings, this app does not repair those settings. It adds a separate warning while it is running.

## Free

- Theme: Default Warning. The on-screen line is "I AM GOING TO DIE IF YOU DON'T PLUG ME IN NOW!"
- Warning percentage: 1% through 10%, default 1%.
- Dismiss by connecting power, pressing Escape, or using the close button.
- Mute sound effects, start at login when installed as an app, and Test SOS.
- Test SOS works on a Mac without an internal battery and does not invent a percentage.

## Pro

Pro is $1, which is 1.00 USD, paid once through Stripe Checkout at https://pay.batterysos.app. It is not a subscription. A license activates on one Mac.

- Themes: Vitals Monitor, Self-Destruct, Reactor Meltdown, Starship Life Support, and Matrix.
- Battery dashboard. Time remaining comes from macOS and can change.
- Early heads-up at 15%, 20%, 30%, or 40%. This does not change the full-screen threshold.
- Snooze for 5, 10, or 15 minutes while running on battery above 1%. At 1%, connect power or dismiss the warning.
- Charge reminders at 80%, 90%, or 100%. These are reminders only. They do not start, stop, or limit charging.
- Quiet hours affect sound only. The default window is 22:00–07:00 and stays off until enabled. The full-screen warning still appears.

## Machines

This build is Apple silicon only. Intel Macs are not supported. The minimum system is macOS 13.

## Do not claim

- Do not say the download is notarized unless a stapled ticket for that exact file has been accepted.
- Do not say charge reminders control charging.
- Do not say there is a self-service license lookup by email. Recovery is support-only after ownership is checked.
